text:
marco_eng: Noticing a small but sustained uptick in 5xx for embed routing behind router-v2 in eu-west1 (canary). A batching edge-case causes null shard keys for some requests. I have a tiny hotpatch: defensive shard-key fallback + config toggle to force single-shard routing. Image: `redwood/router:2026-03-23-hotfix-b`. Need rapid approvals to push with a short window.
tina_rel: Paste the exact diffs and rollback plan. Also @dan_sre for prod smoke.
marco_eng: Diff (high level): 1) fallback shard-key -> uuid-based prefix when missing 2) add metric emit counter `router.shard_fallback` 3) config flag `routing.force_single_shard=false` -> set true during rollout. Rollout: canary 3% -> 15% (10m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (20m). Rollback: flip flag back + redeploy previous image `redwood/router:2026-03-10-prod`.
dan_sre: Quick question: will the flag cause desync for dedicated pools? We should pin image for dedicated.
marco_eng: Good call. We'll pin and set `dedicated_autoupdate=false` for the affected pools during the window.
alex_pm: Customer-facing latency SLOs affected for a small cohort. Execs notified. Need one eng, one SRE, release lead signoff to proceed.
dan_sre: I'll run a prod shadow smoke run and check `router.shard_fallback` metric. ETA ~5m.
ops_oncall: Also confirm no downstream cache invalidation required.
marco_eng: No invalidation expected; fallback only affects routing key calculation. I tested in staging: logs show fallback rate ~0.6% and end-to-end success. Snippet: ```2026-03-23T21:14Z shard_fallback=0.006 errors_5xx=0.002 latency_p95=220ms```
tina_rel: Release lead ok pending SRE +1. Preparing release note: "hotfix(router): fallback shard key & routing toggle to mitigate 5xx". I'll tag support once live.
releasebot: deploy request received: `promote redwood/router:2026-03-23-hotfix-b` -> eu-west1-router-canary. Window: immediate, 60m total.
deploybot: initiating canary -> eu-west1-router-canary (3%)
`cmd: deployctl promote --service router --image redwood/router:2026-03-23-hotfix-b --region eu-west1 --target canary --weight 3`
dan_sre: Shadow smoke results: shard_fallback=0.005, no increased 5xx in canary, traces ok. I'm +1 SRE.
ops_oncall: Verified no cache churn and downstream ops okay. +1 ops.
tina_rel: +1 release lead. Pin will be set.
deploybot: bumping canary to 15% as requested
`cmd: deployctl set-weight --service router --region eu-west1 --weight 15`
marco_eng: Observability: shard_fallback metric at ~0.5% globally in canary, 5xx down to baseline. No burst errors.
dan_sre: Running synthetic buyer-flow check for 12m window. All green. Recommend ramp to 50%.
deploybot: increasing to 50% -> command issued.
marco_eng: Manual spot-checks of traces and error logs look clean. No regressions.
dan_sre: 50% stable for 14m. Approve full shift. :white_check_mark:
releasebot: applying image pin to dedicated pools and toggling `dedicated_autoupdate=false` for affected pool ids.
deploybot: final traffic shift to 100% underway
`cmd: deployctl set-weight --service router --region eu-west1 --weight 100`
marco_eng: Rollout complete. router image `2026-03-23-hotfix-b` at 100% eu-west1. Metrics: 5xx back to baseline, shard_fallback events emitting as expected.
alex_pm: Thank you. Posting release note + support tag now. Please keep pin for 12 hours and then reassess.
dan_sre: I'll keep alerting on for 3 hours then hand back. Logging artifacts: https://internal.redwood/ci/artifacts/1912345670
tina_rel: I'll write a short blurb for the changelog and mark this hotfix as expedited. Closing approvals thread.
marco_eng: Good work team. No rollback needed; holding the pin and monitoring. :thumbsup:
